content.text: The text combines several works. A religious manual explains Holy Matrimony, Holy Order, Penance, and Unction, emphasizing consent, Apostolic Succession, clerical roles, confession, absolution, and healing. Historical chapters recount Lord Durham’s Canadian mission, the rebellions of 1837–38, battles at Lacolle and Odelltown, executions, and later reconciliation. Fiction follows Winton’s “S. W. F. Club,” whose members explore the village, visit the manor, picnic at The Maples and an old fort, and prepare to leave for school. Another story describes Minnie’s mischievous pet monkey Jacko. A Cornish travel narrative records visits to the Lizard, Lizard Lights, Marazion, St. Michael’s Mount, Land’s End, Whitesand Bay, Tintagel, and Boscastle. Finally, on the Big Horn Ranch, Allan and Mandy go fishing, rescue an injured Piegan boy, and meet his returning companions.
